root_cause: layout-1 groups items into visual lines by y then sorts RTL by x. This is correct for classic single-body-column gazette pages with a narrow marginal-caption column, but INTERLEAVES columns on modern justified two-body-column typesetting (pub 2161820, 2021). Needs a balanced-two-body-column handler: detect ~equal columns and read the right column fully (RTL first) then the left, instead of merging across the gap per line.
